title: Code Review & Safety

body.text: — have it check for bugs, security holes, performance, and conventions before it reaches a human reviewer. This lightens the team's load and catches problems early.

example: "Review this PR: find bugs that might slip through, security risks, slow queries, and code that breaks the project's conventions"

title: Safe boundaries

body.text: The principle for controlling an AI agent:
least privilege — give the minimum access needed to work
— the sandbox has no real secrets, merging must go through a human, and AI-written code must pass tests + review like everyone's code.

example: "Team policy: the AI agent may not push directly to main / every PR needs at least 1 human approval"
